jobs.description:
**Job Title:** DEVELOPER L4
  
**City:** Hyderabad
  
**State/Province:** Telangana
  
**Posting Start Date:** 9/2/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Oracle Fusion Middleware .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President Premier Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Some careers open more doors than others.

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

 **Job Purpose**

  

To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high\-net\-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.

 **Responsibility**

  

* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long\-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements

 **Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.**

 **Eligibility \& Educational qualifications**

  

* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4\-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals
* Strong wealth management technical knowledge to provide suitable recommendations and advice
* Experience building trusted relationships with high\-net\-worth individual (HNI) clients as a consistent point of contact
* Capability using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate timely client data
* Experience partnering with Compliance Credit and Risk and Internal Control teams to deliver balanced risk outcomes
* Required local regulatory licences and accreditations for wealth management or equivalent demonstrable experience
* AMFI IRDA NISM XXI A (PMS Certification) and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) or equivalent certification or equivalent demonstrable experience where required by the market.

 **Additional Information**

  

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.

  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are?** **We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill.**  

GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high\-impact, cohort\-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could.  

Then AI changed what "**upskilling**" even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI\-ready versus not.  

So, we built **Outskill**, our AI education arm, to close that gap, practical, implementation\-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today Outskill is one of the largest AI education companies in the world: **16M\+ learners across 160\+ countries**, and programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation. **Our mission: Make 100 million people AI\-ready by 2028\.** **What that actually feels like day to day:** we're 300\+ people, backed by Sequoia, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday.  

If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here.**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------


We're looking for a **high\-performing Enterprise Sales Manager / Senior Manager** to own and scale our most strategic enterprise relationships. This role is responsible for driving end\-to\-end enterprise sales—from consultative discovery and solution design to commercial negotiations, deal closure, and long\-term account growth.
You'll work with global organizations to solve complex workforce transformation challenges through AI\-powered learning solutions. This role requires exceptional consultative selling skills, executive presence, and the ability to navigate complex, multi\-stakeholder buying journeys while building trusted relationships with senior business leaders.**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **End\-to\-End Enterprise Sales**

* Own the complete enterprise sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution consulting, commercial negotiations, contract closure, onboarding, and account growth.
* Develop and execute winning sales strategies for large, multi\-stakeholder enterprise opportunities.
* Drive new business acquisition while expanding strategic customer relationships.

### **Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting**

* Partner with Product, Marketing, and Learning teams to design tailored enterprise solutions aligned with customer business objectives.
* Lead executive presentations, solution demonstrations, RFP responses, proposals, and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Translate complex customer requirements into compelling business cases and solution narratives.

### **Strategic Account Management**

* Build trusted relationships with CXOs, CHROs, L\&D leaders, HR teams, and Digital Transformation stakeholders.
* Identify expansion opportunities through upselling, cross\-selling, renewals, and long\-term strategic partnerships.
* Conduct regular business reviews and proactively drive customer success and account health.

### **Global Client Engagement**

* Manage enterprise customers across international markets and navigate global procurement, legal, commercial, and operational processes.
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for strategic global accounts.
* Build strong relationships across multiple stakeholders, business units, and geographies.

### **Revenue \& Pipeline Management**

* Own individual revenue targets and maintain a healthy enterprise sales pipeline.
* Build accurate forecasts and provide regular pipeline updates to leadership.
* Apply structured deal qualification methodologies to maximize conversion rates and sales efficiency.
* Ensure CRM accuracy and maintain strong sales process discipline.

### **Market Intelligence \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitor activities, and industry developments.
* Share customer insights with Product, Marketing, and Leadership to strengthen go\-to\-market strategy.
* Act as the voice of the enterprise customer and contribute to product positioning and roadmap discussions.

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

* Creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.

* Contribute to solution design by partnering with senior engineers/architects and participating in design reviews to ensure implementations align with technical standards and business needs.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, where approved) to improve development efficiency, testing, and code quality.
* Follow and promote strong engineering practices (code reviews, CI/CD, testing, observability, documentation) and continuously improve the codebase.
* Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into technical deliverables.
* Support security and compliance requirements by applying secure coding practices and adhering to Community Banking standards and applicable regulatory expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Demonstrated experience with Java backend development, object\-oriented design, and common design patterns.
* Experience with AWS (e.g., Aurora Postgres, ECS/Fargate, Glue and/or Airflow) and building distributed services.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to learn quickly in a complex domain.
* Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.
* Hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle. Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Financial services and/or connected commerce experience is a plus, but not required.

* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies

You will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing enterprise software solutions, leveraging technologies such as C\+\+, Java, and modern software architectures. Working closely with architects, product managers, quality engineers, and domain experts, you will help translate customer and business needs into reliable, scalable, and maintainable software solutions. The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, analytical thinking, and a solid understanding of power systems and grid operations. In addition to contributing hands\-on to development, you will influence technical direction, promote engineering best practices, mentor team members, and support product modernization initiatives. This position offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on innovative Grid Software products that are helping shape the future of energy.
**Job Description**
===================


### **Responsibilities**


* Drive the technical execution and evolution of a Grid Software product, delivering reliable and scalable solutions for critical power system and utility applications.
* Design, develop, test, and maintain software components using **C\+\+, Java, and modern software development technologies**, ensuring high quality and maintainability.
* Contribute to product architecture, technical design decisions, and modernization initiatives that improve performance, scalability, security, and long\-term sustainability.
* Collaborate with architects, product managers, domain experts, and global engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into robust software solutions.
* Lead the development of complex features, algorithms, and analytical capabilities that support advanced grid and power system operations.
* Champion engineering best practices, including code reviews, refactoring, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure software development.
* Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and problem\-solving activities.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex product, performance, and production issues across the software stack.
* Drive continuous improvement in software quality, development processes, and team productivity.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver product commitments on time while maintaining a high standard of engineering excellence.

### **Desired Characteristics**


* Strong expertise in **C\+\+ and/or Java** with a deep understanding of software engineering principles and enterprise application development.
* Proven experience contributing to the technical direction and delivery of complex software products and large codebases.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, code quality, refactoring, and maintainable system design.
* Experience with modern full\-stack technologies, REST APIs, databases, cloud\-native development, and distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of object\-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization techniques.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows development environments.
* Understanding of power systems, transmission operations, energy management systems, grid applications, or utility business processes is highly desirable.
* Ability to translate domain knowledge and customer needs into practical and scalable software solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and technical problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent collaboration, communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
* **10\+ years of experience** in software development, enterprise application engineering, or software product development.
* Strong hands\-on experience developing and maintaining software using **C\+\+, Java, or similar object\-oriented programming languages**.
* Experience working on large\-scale, mission\-critical software products throughout the full development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will draw from their experience in contact center workforce management, capacity planning, and operational budgeting; demonstrating their ability to analyze data, drive scheduling decisions, execute process improvements, and deliver results in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment. Experience in BPO vendor management or procurement is a plus but not required.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Execute contact center forecasting models to project staffing needs across internal site locations and BPO vendor sites; ensure alignment with demand plans and hiring targets.  

  

Build and maintain scheduling frameworks for internal and outsourced contact center operations; optimize shift coverage, service levels, and agent utilization across all locations.  

  

Manage day\-to\-day BPO vendor relationships; track performance against SLAs, escalate issues, and drive corrective action plans.  

  

Support procurement activities for BPO vendors; assist with RFP processes, contract renewals, and cost analysis.  

  

Maintain operational budget planning throughout the fiscal year; track spend against plan, identify variances, and recommend adjustments to stay within budget targets.

Analyze key operational metrics (service level, occupancy, shrinkage, attrition) across internal and vendor sites to identify performance gaps and recommend solutions.  

  

Deep dive inefficiencies across internal and vendor operations; own root cause analysis and implement scalable mechanisms to resolve recurring issues.

This is a builder's role — we expect you to form your own point of view on what to build, defend it with evidence, and be accountable for whether it worked

 Own a problem space, not a feature list
   

  

 Develop deep understanding of your area — the users, the jobs they're trying to get done, the workflows around your product, and where the current experience breaks down.

 Ship with your squad
   

  

 Partner with engineering and design from problem framing through release — refinement, trade\-off calls, scope decisions, and unblocking during the sprint.
   

  

 Break large initiatives into releasable increments so customers see value early and often.
   

  

 Own launch readiness: enablement content, release notes, support handoff, and rollout plan.
   

  

 Work from evidence
   

  

 Talk to customers regularly — discovery calls, feedback sessions, and reviewing real usage in the product.
   

  

 Define the instrumentation and success metrics for what you ship, then go back and check whether the metrics moved.
   

  

 Manage stakeholders across regions
   

  

 Represent your area to sales, customer success, support, and leadership; translate customer escalations and field requests into product signal without letting the loudest voice set the roadmap.
   

  

 Work effectively across time zones with counterparts in the US and EMEA..
   

  

**You Have Got What It Take If You Have**
 2–4 years in product management, including at least 2 years owning a product area for a B2B or enterprise SaaS product.
   

  

 A track record of features you shipped and can speak to concretely: what problem it solved, what you decided and why, what the outcome was, and what you'd do differently.
   

  

 Strong written communication. You can write a PRD an engineer can build from and a one\-pager an executive can decide from.
   

  

 Comfort with data — you can pull and interpret product analytics, define events worth tracking, and reason about a funnel without waiting for someone else to build the dashboard.
   

  

 Experience working directly with engineering in an agile environment, including making scope trade\-offs under real deadlines.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.
   

  

**Nice to have**
 Domain background in HR tech, learning management, talent development, recruiting, or workforce planning.
   

  

 Experience with AI/ML\-driven product features — recommendations, matching, search relevance, or agent\-based workflows — including how to evaluate quality and handle failure modes.
   

  

 Experience shipping localized products or working with globally distributed engineering teams.
   

  

 Exposure to enterprise sales cycles, RFPs, or public\-sector customers

 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**About Wise**
 Wise is building money without borders. Our customers should be able to move, hold, receive, and spend money internationally with a product that is fast, transparent, low\-cost, and safe.
   

  

 Verification is central to that mission. We need to keep financial crime out of Wise, meet regulatory obligations across many markets, and make it easy for legitimate customers to get started and use our products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global KYC and Onboarding Squad is improving Wise's KYC and onboarding experience by reducing three things at the same time:
   

  

* Financial crime risk, by making reviews, controls, and decisioning more effective.
* Operational cost, by automating repeatable work and improving how agents handle complex cases.
* Customer friction, by making verification clearer, faster, and easier to complete.


 Business Onboarding Verification focuses on business customers. Businesses are not simple identity objects: they are legal entities connected to directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorised signatories, employees, documents, registry data, vendor data, ownership structures, risk signals, and market\-specific requirements.
   

  

 That makes KYB one of Wise's most complex verification domains. It is also one of the biggest opportunities to improve customer experience, reduce manual work, improve control quality, and build better risk decisioning.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of the workstreams within Business Onboarding Verification. Each PM within the team owns a complex product area end to end, from discovery and roadmap through delivery, measurement, and iteration.

* Balance tactical delivery with long\-term product foundations.

* Your workstream has a clear roadmap with explicit priorities and measurable outcomes.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Verantwortlich für die abgestimmte Zusammenarbeit mit Anwendungs\- oder Domänenführern, die als leitender technischer Produktmanager fungieren, um eine klare strategische Ausrichtung zu erstellen, die vom Produktentwicklungsteam festgelegt wird. Sie arbeiten mit dem Team zusammen und stellen klare und festgelegte Anforderungen, um die Bereitstellung von Produktmerkmalen und ‑funktionalität zu ermöglichen. Ihre Priorität ist die nahtlose Integration und Ausrichtung der Perspektiven eines breiten Spektrums von Stakeholdern, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf: Kunden, Prozesseigentümer, Unternehmensarchitekten, Anwendungsmanager, Entwicklungsteams und technische Architekten.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Rollen und VerantwortlichkeitenIm Rahmen dieser Rolle werden Sie:
   

  

* Interagiert mit Kunden/Stakeholdern bei der Erfassung von VOC\-Anforderungen, der Feinabstimmung und dem Einholen von Produktfeedback.
* Arbeitet mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Funktionen und Produkte bereitzustellen.
* Zeigt ein zunehmendes Verständnis des Technologie\-Stacks und seiner Auswirkungen auf das Endprodukt.
* Arbeitet regelmäßig mit UX Design zusammen, um Kunden kennenzulernen und Verhaltensweisen zu verstehen.
* Führt Kunden\- und Stakeholder\-Interviews durch und arbeitet Personas aus.
* Demonstriert die Fähigkeit, Kunden und Produktmanager durch Überzeugung und Einflussnahme zu beeinflussen.
* Arbeitet mit PM zusammen, um die kurzfristige Roadmap für Release\- und Sprint\-Rückstände für MVPs und vierteljährliche Releases zu erstellen.
* Verantwortlich für und verwaltet den Rückstand; bestellt und priorisiert fortlaufend, um sicherzustellen, dass 1–2 Sprints/Iterationen des Rückstandes immer bereit sind.
* Priorisiert kontinuierlich in Übereinstimmung mit dem Verständnis und der Validierung von Kundenproblemen und \-bedürfnissen.
* Arbeitet mit Produktmanagern/TPMs zusammen, um Features in konsumierbare User Stories zu zerlegen.
* Arbeitet häufig (50 % der Zeit) mit dem Entwicklungsteam; ermöglicht Gespräche, bietet Klarheit, Story\-Akzeptanz und \-Verbesserung, Tests und Validierung; trägt zur Gestaltung von Aktivitäten und Entscheidungen bei.
* Übersetzt unstrukturierte oder mehrdeutige Arbeitsanforderungen in umsetzbare User Stories und Arbeitseinheiten.
* Arbeitet mit Service\-Eigentümern/Entwicklungsmanagern zusammen, um einen gesunden Entwicklungsprozess sicherzustellen.
* Wendet eine agile Methodik an.GrundqualifikationenDiese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung im technischen Produktmanagement. Der akademische Wissensstand befindet sich auf Bachelor\-Abschluss\-NiveauGewünschte EigenschaftenTechnische Fachkentnisse:
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Bezug auf Softwaredesign und Codierungsprinzipien
* Erfahrung in einer agilen Umgebung
* Vertrautheit mit verschiedenen Implementierungsmöglichkeiten
* Demonstriert Kenntnisse zu technischen Themen wie Caching, APIs, Datenübertragung, Skalierbarkeit und SicherheitGeschäftssinn:
* Zeigt Initiative bei der Erforschung alternativer Technologien und Lösungsansätzen
* Kenntnisse in der Aufschlüsselung von Problemen, der Dokumentation von Problemstellungen und der Abschätzung des Aufwands.
* Hat die Fähigkeit, die Auswirkung von Technologieentscheidungen zu analysieren
* Verhandlungsgeschick, um Stakeholder zusammenzubringen und dem Scrum\-Team eine einzige synthetisierte Perspektive zu vermitteln. Gleicht Wertversprechen für konkurrierende Stakeholder ab.
* Demonstriert Kenntnisse des Wettbewerbsumfelds

* Erkennt präventiv die nachgelagerten Konsequenzen und passt die einflussnehmende Strategie effektiv an, um ein positives Ergebnis zu erzielen.
* Kann klar artikulieren, was hinter Entscheidungen und nachgelagerten Implikationen steckt. Kontinuierliche Reflexion über Erfolge und Misserfolge als Hilfe zur Verbesserung von Leistung und zur Entscheidungsfindung.

* Besitzt die Fähigkeit, andere effektiv beim Erlernen kritischer Denkansätze zu leiten und begleiten.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. * Partner with engineering teams to ensure ServiceNow functional and technical design requirements are understood, documented, tested, and validated

* Apply consultative influence, troubleshooting skills, and product leadership to drive outcomes without direct people\-management responsibility
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, Technical Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar technology product role
* Experience translating business needs into technical requirements for engineering teams
* ServiceNow experience, including understanding of workflows, configuration concepts, functional design, technical design, integrations, and platform capabilities
* Project management experience, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, priorities, and cross\-functional coordination
* Foundational understanding of AI concepts, automation, and how AI\-enabled capabilities can improve workflows and product outcomes
* Solid requirements gathering, workflow documentation, user story writing, acceptance criteria definition, and stakeholder facilitation skills

* Proven solid troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills across business process and technical domains

Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

Role Overview
   

  

 Application
   

  

**Senior Product Manager Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)** 
**About the Company** 
 At Redpin we simplify life's most important payments. Buying a new property overseas can be a stressful time, especially when it comes to moving your money. Through our Currencies Direct and TorFX brands we've been helping people do just that for over 25 years. With recent investment we're now on a mission to build a new range of digital products and services that will make moving money Internationally for Real Estate purchases even easier. We're on a mission to become the solution for Real Estate payments everywhere. To do this, we are transitioning our business from a horizontal FX platform to a verticalized, embedded software company, as we look to the future and Redpin 2\.0\. As part of this mission, we're thrilled to announce we are open a new office in Hyderabad! We're recruiting for several Engineering roles covering front end (React.js) features.
 **About the Role**
* Our Operations teams such as Payment Ops, Compliance Ops, Customer Ops \& treasury Ops have multiple portals and we want to unify all of them. There is no dedicated product owner for stakeholder intake.
* Similarly the Client operations does not have a dedicated product support to capture and identify the issues, prioritize them.


 Currently the platform roadmap is managed informally across multiple teams without clear ownership.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Platform to fill this critical gap. This person will be the strategic partner to SRE, Operations and Core Platform Engineering, ensuring the platform runs reliably, the right work gets prioritized, and business stakeholders have a clear intake path.
   

  

**What You Will Do** 
 \- Build a new Admin Tool bringing multiple operations groups together.
 **\- Run the Business Well** 
**\- Manage Intake from Business Teams** 
**\- Define Product Requirements for Core Platform Engineering team** 
**\- Govern Production Data \& Change Control** 
**What You Bring** 
**Required** 
**Preferred**
* Own Site and Platform Reliability Goals
* Define and maintain SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLIs (Service Level Indicators) for all customer\-critical flows.
* Stakeholder management \- work with various stakeholders within operations and client facing teams, understand their priorities and needs.
* Translate product expectations into measurable reliability targets that SRE can engineer to.
* Identify and prioritise Top Flows — the highest\-impact user journeys — and ensure they are monitored and protected.
* Lead quarterly reliability reviews with engineering and business stakeholders.
* Own "Keep Lights On" accountability — ensuring operational continuity across Pay Ops, Customer Ops, and Compliance Ops.
* Prioritise the work on the roadmap, making trade\-offs explicit and visible \- all by using data.
* Track live operational health metrics and escalate risks proactively to engineering and business leadership.
* Coordinate incident response communications across stakeholders when SLA thresholds are at risk.
* Serve as the single point of coordination for platform requests from Pay Ops, Customer Ops, and Compliance Ops.
* Run a structured intake process — triage, size, prioritize, and schedule work transparently.
* Reduce ad\-hoc requests and unplanned interruptions to SRE engineering capacity.
* Maintain a visible backlog that business stakeholders can track and trust.
* Author clear functional and non\-functional requirements for platform features and infrastructure investments.
* Partner with Core Platform Engineering to ensure requirements are feasible, scoped, and well\-accepted.
* Define and track success metrics for platform feature launches.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap that aligns platform investment with business priorities.
* Own the end\-to\-end process for authorizing access to production data and approving production changes.
* Balance operational agility with compliance and risk requirements.
* Work with Compliance Ops to ensure change control processes meet regulatory requirements.
* Maintain audit trails and documentation for production change approvals.
* 10\+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 5 years in a platform, infrastructure, or operational tools context.
* Strong understanding of how operational processes and tools work, understanding various operational workflows.
* Strong understanding of SRE principles: SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident management, and on\-call operations.
* Proven ability to translate technical complexity into clear business requirements and executive communications.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders in regulated or compliance\-sensitive environments.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage a prioritized product backlog under competing demands.
* Background in fintech, payments, or other high\-availability, high\-compliance environments.
* Experience running incident retrospectives and problem management processes.
* MBA or engineering degree — or equivalent hands\-on experience.

**Role Summary**  

This position will support the People Analytics \& Reporting team with a focus on Workday reporting delivery, stakeholder support, data quality, and operational continuity. The role will partner with a centralized global team of people analytics and reporting to develop, maintain, and enhance reporting solutions that support People business priorities, workforce insights, and data governance.

* Own day\-to\-day Workday reporting responsibilities, including report maintenance, enhancement requests, troubleshooting, and stakeholder follow\-up.
* Design, build, test, and deploy Workday reports, including custom reports, advanced reports, matrix reports, and calculated fields.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements, clarify reporting needs, and translate requests into effective reporting solutions.
* Support workforce management, data quality, compliance, and operational reporting needs across geographies and functional areas.
* Maintain and improve existing reports, documentation, report inventories, and standard operating procedures to ensure knowledge continuity and long\-term sustainability.
* Provide end\-user support, training, and guidance related to Workday reporting outputs, report usage, and reporting processes.
* Develop a strong understanding of Workday data structures, business processes, and reporting dependencies to improve data accuracy and usability.
* Analyze complex business questions and data challenges to produce focused insights, identify trends, and support decision\-making.
* Prioritize a mix of transactional requests, production support, and project\-based work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Maintain confidentiality and appropriately protect employee personal data in accordance with internal policies and data governance standards.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders, provide status updates, manage expectations, and escalate risks or blockers when needed.

**Qualifications**  

* 3\+ years of experience in HR, HR systems, people analytics, reporting, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Workday HCM reporting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of Workday reporting, including advanced reporting, matrix reporting, calculated fields, and related reporting functionality.
* Experience designing and developing business\-facing and internal reports with a focus on usability, accuracy, and stakeholder needs.
* Knowledge of multiple Workday functional areas such as Core HCM, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Security, and Reporting.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills.

* Customer\-service mindset with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to document processes clearly and support knowledge transfer across the team.

* Exposure to Workday Prism Analytics, including data preparation, transformation, or reporting use cases.
* Experience with Workday Worksheets or similar self\-service reporting and analysis capabilities.
* Familiarity with ETL concepts, data pipelines, data movement, or data transformation processes.
* Exposure to Fivetran or similar data integration and pipeline automation tools.

jobs.description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

**About The Team**
 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The IT\&D Business Analyst – SAP Pricing is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and maintaining SAP Pricing processes across the global Order to Cash (O2C), Revenue Management, and Commercial Operations cycles. This role collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and IT teams to ensure accurate pricing, stable system performance, adherence to commercial policies, and continuous process improvement. The position plays a key role in SAP ECC deployment, S/4HANA readiness, pricing enhancements, issue resolution, and global commercial transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Support SAP SD Pricing processes across quotation, sales order, delivery, billing, and rebate/discount management.
* Work with Commercial, Sales, and Finance users to gather requirements, analyse pricing issues, and propose SAP best‑practice solutions.
* Configure pricing procedures, condition types, access sequences, condition records, surcharges, discounts, scales, tax‑relevant pricing elements, and relevant O2C settings.
* Support testing cycles including unit testing, integration testing, UAT, and cutover preparation for pricing deployments.
* Prepare functional specifications for pricing enhancements, reports, interfaces, outputs, and workflow improvements.
* Monitor integrations across MM (purchase pricing), FI (billing accounting), Vistex (if applicable), and Tax engines.
* Assist business teams during month‑end and quarter‑end activities such as price validation, rebate accruals, credit/debit note processing, and pricing\-related reconciliations.
* Resolve day‑to‑day operational issues related to pricing errors, incorrect condition records, billing price mismatches, credit notes, and customer pricing disputes.
* Collaborate with managed service providers to ensure timely incident resolution and SLA compliance.
* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring pricing issues and recommend permanent fixes.
* Ensure compliance with audit requirements, commercial policy controls, ITGC, ITAC, and internal control frameworks related to pricing.
* Maintain accurate documentation for pricing configuration, master data, process flows, and change logs.
* Work with SAP Security \& GRC teams for pricing role access, mitigating controls, and SoD checks involving O2C.
* Support pricing master data governance for condition records, customer‑specific pricing, material pricing, rebate agreements, and tax‑related pricing data.
* Recommend opportunities for automation, digitalization, and pricing workflow improvements.

**About the job**
-----------------


Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes way beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way.  

  

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.



Google Silicon is a custom silicon group in consumer hardware. The SiValSW (Silicon Validation Software) team's mission is to create a unified development platform for system software (SoCs, infrastructures, and accelerators/custom\-IPs) with backends on emulator, simulator, and silicon. The team develops portable and reusable system software scaled across different families and tiers of SoCs, and supports system software deployment for tape\-out, bring\-up, and validation efforts across both Silicon Validation (SiVal) and System Level Test (SLT).


Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead an engineering team in driving software strategy, architectural design, and execution for pre\-silicon and post\-silicon validation across custom SoC families.
* Deliver boot platform software and lowlevel drivers tailored for silicon validation and SLT execution.
* Develop firmware and system software for key IP blocks, including power, peripherals, memory modules etc.
* Drive software development across core domains including platform software (BSP, firmware, drivers), security architecture/systems, and system power and performance.
* Mentor and guide team members on software architecture, code quality, and engineering best practices, fostering technical excellence.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Principal Product Manager – Core Intelligence and Optimization**

**Target in India \| L7 Individual Contributor**

**About the Job – Principal Product Manager, Core Intelligence and Optimization**


Target’s stores operate at extraordinary scale and complexity. Every day, millions of signals across inventory, workload, space, team member activity and physical environments create opportunities to make smarter operational decisions.


As a **Principal Product Manager for Core Intelligence and Optimization**, you will help shape how Target turns those signals into intelligence.


You will be a senior product thought leader working across Core Intelligence to identify and solve some of Target’s hardest problems at the intersection of **AI, data science, operational intelligence, recommendation, optimization and automation**.


Your role will extend beyond any single product. You will explore emerging opportunities, frame ambiguous problems, incubate new intelligence capabilities and connect products across the intelligence lifecycle—from understanding operational context through recommendation and optimization.


You will influence Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations leaders across the enterprise and help shape Target's evolving approach to intelligent Store systems.

**Core Intelligence Optimization Product Strategy \& Innovation**

* Shape long\-term product thinking for Core Intelligence and identify emerging opportunities across intelligent systems, AI/ML, recommendation, optimization and automation.
* Develop strong product perspectives on how Target can use operational and physical signals to create differentiated Store intelligence.
* Identify complex, cross\-cutting problems where intelligence can create meaningful value for guests, team members and Store operations.
* Translate ambiguous opportunities into clear problem spaces, hypotheses and product strategies.
* Help determine where Target should build reusable intelligence capabilities versus domain\-specific solutions.

**Discovery, Experimentation \& Incubation**

* Lead discovery for emerging intelligence opportunities that span existing product or organizational boundaries.
* Partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX and Operations to explore problems and potential solutions.
* Use simulation, experimentation, prototypes and data to rapidly validate hypotheses.
* Incubate new intelligence capabilities until there is sufficient evidence and clarity to scale.
* Establish measurable feedback loops that connect intelligence and recommendations to operational outcomes.
* Challenge teams to demonstrate value and learning before scaling investment.

**Enterprise Product Leadership**

* Connect intelligence capabilities across products and experiences to create coherent, reusable systems rather than isolated solutions.
* Influence product strategy and investment decisions across multiple Product groups.
* Navigate complex technical, operational and organizational trade\-offs.
* Communicate sophisticated intelligence concepts in clear language that enables senior leaders to make decisions.
* Serve as a trusted product thought partner to Product Directors and senior PTUX leaders.

**Elevate Product Craft**

* Raise the quality of product discovery, strategy, experimentation and outcome measurement across Core Intelligence.
* Coach and mentor Product Managers without direct people\-management responsibility.
* Introduce product practices appropriate for AI/ML and intelligence products where outputs may be probabilistic and continuously learning.
* Help teams move from feature and solution thinking toward problem, outcome and capability thinking.
* Build reusable frameworks that strengthen product decision\-making across the organization.

**About You**

* 4\-year college degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree is a plus.
* 8\+ years of Product Management experience with significant experience solving highly complex product problems.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with AI/ML, data products, recommendation systems, optimization, intelligent platforms or similarly complex technical domains is strongly preferred.
* Exceptional problem framing, systems thinking and product judgment.
* Strong discovery and experimentation mindset.
* Ability to translate emerging technology into meaningful customer and business opportunities.
* Proven ability to influence senior Product, Technology, Data Science and business leaders without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal storytelling skills.
* Thrives in ambiguity and is energized by problems where the answer has not yet been defined.

 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35 million actively use credit cards. jobs.title: Product Manager II - Ads
jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a PM2, you will independently own a product area or platform charter end\-to\-end — from strategy and roadmap to execution and business impact. You will operate with significant autonomy and drive initiatives across customer experience, platform scalability, automation, growth, and monetization. You will be expected to think beyond features and solve for systems, operational leverage, and long\-term platform evolution.
   

  

**What you’ll do?**
* Build Customer Empathy \- Regularly engage with customers, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and unmet needs through both qualitative and quantitative insights.
* Drive Product Strategy \- Define long\-term product vision and quarterly roadmap aligned with business goals, customer outcomes, and platform scalability.
* Build Scalable Products \- Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and operations teams to build reliable, scalable, and high\-impact products.
* Lead Product Execution \- Write high\-quality product specifications, prioritize effectively, manage tradeoffs, and ensure timely execution across releases.
* Own Metrics \& Outcomes \- Define success metrics, monitor business impact, and driveiterative improvements through experimentation and data analysis.
* Ecosystem Collaboration \- Partner with banks, regulators, vendors, and ecosystem players to co\-build industry\-defining solutions.


**What are we looking for?**
 1\.4–7 years of product management experience
   

  

* Strong product execution and prioritization skills
* Experience owning business metrics and customer outcomes
* Strong analytical thinking and experimentation mindset
* Ability to work across technical and business stakeholders
* Systems thinking and platform orientation
* Strong customer empathy balanced with business acumen
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and fast\-paced environments

**About MantriAI**
 MantriAI is a boutique search firm for technology companies. We are running this mandate for a client \- a venture\-backed AI product company headquartered in Bengaluru, building for a global user base in the millions.
   

  

 All applications come to MantriAI first. We screen, and only shortlisted profiles reach the client. Company details are shared after the screening call.
   

  

**The role**
 This is the company's first product manager. The product you own is the company's own internal platform: the tools, automations and data the team runs on. The mandate is to help a lean team do the work of a much larger one. Your customers are the internal teams: support, marketing, hiring, engineering, and the founders themselves. You find where their time goes, decide what to fix first, and get it fixed. Much of this you build yourself with low\-code platforms, scripts, APIs and LLM APIs. When something needs real engineering, you write the spec and make the case for engineering time. No team reports to you and none is planned. The role reports into the founding team.
   

  

**What you will do**
 \- Treat internal teams as customers: sit with them, map where their time goes, find the repetitive work and the broken processes
   

 \- Decide what gets built, what gets bought, what gets refused, and in which order
   

 \- Build much of it yourself: workflow automations, dashboards, admin tools, and LLM\-based workflows for support triage, document handling and reporting
   

 \- When something needs real engineering, write the spec, make the case for engineering time, and see it through
   

 \- Own the internal data layer: the dashboards and reports the founders run the company on, and the plumbing behind them
   

 \- Measure adoption and hours saved. Retire what stops being used
   

  

**What we are looking for**
 \- Around 2 to 6 years in product, engineering, founder's office or internal tools roles where you personally decided what to build and then built or shipped it.
   

 \- Product judgment you can show: problems you chose over others, things you refused to build, things you bought instead, tools you built and later retired
   

 \- Working hands: SQL, APIs, and at least one automation or internal\-tools platform such as n8n, Make, Zapier or Retool. Comfortable shipping with AI coding tools.
   

 \- Real LLM work since 2024: API integrations, agents or AI\-assisted builds that ran in production beyond a demo
   

 \- Able to write a clear spec and argue for it with people who have other priorities
   

 \- Based in Bengaluru, or ready to relocate. In office, six days a week.
   

  

**Good to have**
 \- Time at a young AI product company, or an early\-stage startup where you owned operations tooling
   

 \- A portfolio, a GitHub profile, or a written record of tools you have built
   

  

**Logistics**
 \- Full\-time role. Six\-day work week. WFO in Bengaluru
   

 \- Notice period of 30 days or less preferred
   

  

**Hiring process**
 1\. Screening call with MantriAI
   

 2\. A 30\-minute Product round with MantriAI
   

 3\. Client rounds (preferably in\-person)
   

 4\. Offer rollout within 2 days of the final round
   

*Posted by MantriAI, search partner for this role. Shortlisted applications hear from us within 48 hours.*

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**Job Purpose**

The MDM Specialist will play a pivotal role in the Enterprise Data Management team, focusing on managing and optimizing Master Data Management (MDM) processes using Informatica Cloud (IDMC). This role requires a seasoned professional who can lead a team, manage stakeholders, and ensure the seamless operation of MDM services. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in MDM, be certified in ITIL and IDMC MDM, and possess excellent leadership and communication skills.


**Quality Responsibilities:**

* Read and understand all relevant Quality Management System documents and Operating Procedures relevant to your job role.
* Perform duties in a compliant manner and behave in accordance with our Quality Management System requirements to ensure cGMP standards are maintained.

**Quality and Compliance:**

* Comply to departmental governance procedures.
* Report any issues and risk encountered as per department processes.
* Ensure any owned risks are mitigated.
* Ensure all owned CAPA’s and actions are completed within the agreed timeframe.

* MDM Strategy and Implementation:



	+ Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of MDM solutions using Informatica Cloud (IDMC).

* Service Management:



	+ Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of MDM services, ensuring high availability and performance.
	+ Implement ITIL best practices to manage incidents, problems, and changes effectively.

	+ Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions to enhance MDM efficiency and effectiveness.
	+ Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in MDM and Informatica Cloud.

**Personal challenges:**

* Manage time pressure and the balance of personal/family time and work time.
* Balance the needs of numerous customer groups and consistently making sound decisions.
* Adjusted working hours to work with sites in other time zones.

**Specialized Knowledge:**

**Basic Requirements:**

* **Experience:**


	+ Minimum of 7 years of experience in Master Data Management (Product \& Customer), with a focus on Informatica Cloud (IDMC).
	+ Proven experience in managing teams and leading MDM projects.
* **Certifications:**


	+ ITIL Certification.
	+ Informatica Cloud (IDMC) MDM Certification.
* **Skills:**


	+ Core MDM SaaS Configurations
	
	
	
		- Business Entity Modelling i.e. expertise in designing extendible data models including complex hierarchies and relationships
		- Match \& Merge Logic i.e. configuration of match rules, tuning and defining survivorship/trust rules
		- Data stewardship workflows i.e. designing and implementing governance workflows for reviews and exception handling
	+ Integration \& Orchestration
	
	
	
		- CDI (Cloud data integration) Building high performance ingress/egress jobs using Informatica connections with source and target systems
		- CAI (Cloud application integration) Building real time, event driven integrations using APIs (REST/SOAP) to sync MDM data with operational systems like SAP or Salesforce
	+ Proficiency in Pyhton, SQL and Java related to IDMC development
	+ IDMC Rest APIs

	+ Informatica transformation language

	+ Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

**Job description**

Requisition ID: 1735914
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**

  


**Description**



EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.



Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.

  



Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end\-to\-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:


* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery \& Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re\-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators


Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker\-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.

  


**Role Overview**



The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk\-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure\-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA\-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source\-to\-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation\-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high\-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
* Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
* Perform data profiling and fit\-for\-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source\-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
* Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off\-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA\-CCR, and operational risk.
* Develop source\-to\-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
* Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source\-to\-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
* Map data elements to Axiom\-required…

jobs.description:
**About eGovernments \& DIGIT:** 




  





 eGovernments (eGov), is a pioneering tech\-for\-good organization that exists to drive exponential impact in public service delivery at speed \& scale. We are on a mission to enhance the ease of living for citizens by improving access to essential public services. Our work involves:
 


* **Driving digital transformation globally** 
 with our open\-source platform, DIGIT (Digital Infrastructure for Governance, Impact, and Transformation), to empower nations on their journey towards modernized public services.
* **Providing strategic guidance** 
 to countries on harnessing digital public goods (DPGs) for the effective transformation of their digital services and governance.
* **Fostering dynamic networks** 
 that accelerate the adoption of digital solutions, facilitating exponential progress and innovation within governments and communities.



  





 Our platform, DIGIT, has already benefited over 160 million citizens and continues to expand its reach, touching the lives of over 2\.5 billion people worldwide. Practice areas we work in include local governance, public health, public finance, water, sanitation and climate. Our work spans across 10 countries globally and 2,600 towns and cities across 16 states in India.
 



 If you’re passionate about revolutionizing public service delivery and enhancing the lives of billions, we’d love for you to join our team. Whether you are in a hands\-on role or supporting from behind the scenes, your contributions are vital and impactful. Join us in making a transformative difference!
 



  





**Why work with us?** 



* **Make a Large Scale Impact:** 
 Contribute to projects with the potential to drive significant societal change. Gain experience tackling diverse challenges on both national and global stages.
* **Learn from the Best:** 
 Receive mentorship from leading experts and professionals within our rich ecosystem, broadening your perspectives and expertise.
* **Harness Technology for Good:** 
 Be part of a team dedicated to using technology to address real\-world problems and enhance the lives of citizens.
* **Grow and Lead:** 
 Develop essential skills and seize remarkable opportunities to lead initiatives that shape your career, all within an environment of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.



  





**Read more about the work of eGov Global:** 




 1\.
 
 https://egov.global/
 




 2\.
 
 https://www.digit.org/
 




  





**About the Role** 




 The Business Systems Analyst (Global Delivery) acts as the strategic bridge between external public\-sector stakeholders (e.g., Ministries of Health, implementation partners) and core engineering teams. This role will drive the end\-to\-end implementation of the open\-source DIGIT platform across international deployments, converting complex country health campaigns and public workflows into scalable technical specifications, intuitive process flows, and high\-impact digital solutions. This position will be based in Bangalore and with periodic travel to partner locations in India and Africa.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Requirements \& Functional Spec:** 
 Map current\-state and future\-state workflows into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specifications (FRS), Data Flow Diagrams (DFDs), and UML models. Design wireframes and process flows using Figma or Balsamiq to visualize solutions for partners.
* **Agile Solution Delivery:** 
 Translate complex partner needs into user stories and acceptance criteria. Facilitate Agile ceremonies, manage backlog prioritization, and evaluate Change Requests (CRs) against critical campaign deadlines and scope.
* **Stakeholder Alignment \& Negotiation:** 
 Lead technical discussions, product demos, and solution proposals with Ministry of Health (MoH) partners and internal product teams. Drive agreement on technological recommendations by clearly articulating business value and trade\-offs.
* **Data Analytics \& Impact Monitoring:** 
 Establish Monitoring \& Evaluation (M\&E) campaign metrics, design reporting dashboards, and extract insights from system data to write case studies, measure platform adoption, and inform future product roadmap decisions.
* **Testing, Training \& Adoption:** 
 Write functional test cases alongside QA teams, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions, obtain formal client sign\-offs, and produce user manuals and SOPs to drive ground\-level adoption.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a quantitative field. Master’s degree in Management, Public Health, or Engineering preferred.
* **Professional Certifications:** 
 CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), CCBA (Certification of Capability in Business Analysis), PMI\-PBA, or IIBA\-AAC certification is strongly preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of Business Systems Analyst experience delivering mid\-to\-large\-scale digital implementations end\-to\-end. Experience with public sector, global health, or e\-Governance platforms is highly preferred.
* **Technical Capabilities:** 
 Proficiency in Agile/Scrum, SDLC, SQL, wireframing tools (Figma/Balsamiq), process modeling (UML, BPMN), and advanced MS Excel/PowerPoint.
* **Core Competencies:** 
 Strong analytical and quantitative problem\-solving skills; proven ability to manage ambiguity in fast\-paced environments; exceptional stakeholder management and presentation skills; willingness to travel globally on short notice.

* Able to negotiate and gain agreement, with external stakeholders (MoH/ partners) and internal teams, on technology recommendations by clearly articulating the benefits.
